ExecutiveSummary: SmartHire AI is an innovative platform designed to revolutionize the CV screening and interview process for HR managers and job applicants. By leveraging AI technology, the platform aims to automate the initial stages of recruitment, making it easier to filter out unqualified candidates and conduct personalized digital interviews. This will save time for HR managers, improve the quality of candidates selected for interviews, and provide a more transparent and efficient application experience for job seekers.
Background: In today's competitive job market, HR managers face the challenge of sifting through a large number of CVs, many of which are generated using AI and may not accurately reflect a candidate's true qualifications. This makes it difficult to identify genuinely interested and qualified candidates. Additionally, the traditional interview process is time-consuming and often lacks transparency. SmartHire AI aims to address these issues by automating CV screening and conducting digital interviews using AI technology.
Objectives: Automate the CV screening process to filter out unqualified candidates.
Conduct personalized digital interviews using AI technology.
Provide transparent feedback to job applicants about their application status.
Notify HR managers about candidates who pass the screening and interview stages.
Integrate with Google APIs for email notifications and calendar scheduling.
Scope: The scope of SmartHire AI includes developing a comprehensive platform that automates the initial stages of the hiring process. The platform will feature a job applicant portal for CV uploads, application tracking, and digital interviews, as well as an HR manager portal for job posting creation, AI interview setup, and application statistics review. The platform will be a progressive web app compatible with tablets and iPads on both Android and iOS, and all data will be stored locally on the client's systems.
Deliverables: Job Applicant Portal: Allows applicants to upload CVs, track application status, and participate in digital interviews.
HR Manager Portal: Enables HR managers to create job postings, customize AI interview questions, and review application statistics.
AI-Powered CV Screening: Automatically filters CVs based on job requirements.
AI-Powered Digital Interviews: Conducts interviews using a combination of pre-recorded and real-time customized questions.
Email Notifications: Uses Google API to send email notifications to HR managers and applicants.
Progressive Web App: Ensures compatibility with tablets and iPads on both Android and iOS.
Local Data Storage: Stores all data locally on the client's systems to ensure data security.

Risks.RiskDescription: Data Security and Privacy: Since the platform will store sensitive personal data locally, there is a risk of data breaches or unauthorized access.
MitigationStrategies: Implement robust encryption for data storage and transmission.
Set up secure access controls and user authentication mechanisms.
Conduct regular security audits and vulnerability assessments.

Risks.RiskDescription: AI Accuracy and Fairness: The AI system used for CV screening and digital interviews may not accurately assess candidates, leading to potential biases or incorrect rejections.
MitigationStrategies: Regularly train and update the AI models with diverse and representative data.
Implement a feedback loop where HR managers can review and correct AI decisions.
Conduct bias testing and audits to ensure fairness in AI decision-making.

Risks.RiskDescription: System Scalability: As the platform grows, it may face challenges in handling an increasing number of job postings and applicants efficiently.
MitigationStrategies: Design the system architecture with scalability in mind, leveraging AWS's scalable infrastructure.
Implement performance optimization techniques to handle high loads.
Conduct load testing to identify and address potential bottlenecks.

Provide a dashboard for HR managers to track the status of job applications. This includes viewing statistics on the number of applicants, those who passed the CV screening, and those who passed the digital interview.
